title: Trapped Rainwater
prompt:
You are given a slice of non-negative integers `heights` describing an elevation map, where each bar has width 1. After it rains, water collects in the dips between taller bars. Return the total units of water that are trapped. Water spills off both ends of the map. The total can exceed u32, so return u64.

Signature: `fn trapped_water(heights: &[u32]) -> u64`

Aim for O(n) time; O(1) extra space is possible with two pointers.

Example:
  trapped_water(&[3, 0, 2, 0, 4]) -> 7
  trapped_water(&[0, 1, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, 1]) -> 6
